c74object.name: evi.korgms10~
c74object.digest: 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
c74object.description:
evi.korgms10~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms10.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms10~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
The 'Korg 35' chip was found in the MS-10 and early MS-20 synthesisers - different to the later dual-amplifier Korg OTA chip found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers.

inlet.description: Filter resonance 0..1. As in the original analog circuit, lowpass output level is resonance dependent!

outlet.description: Main 12dB lowpass output. As in the original analog circuit, lowpass output level is resonance dependent!
Quirky 12dB highpass output derived from Sallen Key states.
Quirky 12dB bandpass output derived from Sallen Key states.

attribute.name: noiselevel
attribute.description: Amplitude level of gaussian noise recirculation in filter, 0..1 remapped 0.. 10% of gaussian level. Adding noise is not required for self oscillation, but for sound design.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: If on (1) the filter is 2x oversampled. If off (0, the default), the filter runs at samplerate. Oversampling is recommended to deal with the nonlinear behaviour of the filter, but is expensive because of the multimode outputs.

c74object.discussion: Unofficially: an erratic, out-of-control and out-of-tune aggressive filter for experiments and fun times. Notice that for the 12dB Lowpass, filter level is resonance-dependent when resonance is less than 0.5. This is left as a quirky feature, not a bug :-)
